pkgmetadata.longdescription: ctg-ssh-ca renews the SSH host certificate and the per-user certificate of a machine by proof of possession against the owner's personal CA signer on the tailnet, installs host certificates (sshd HostCertificate drop-in validated with sshd -t) and fetches the key revocation list. Fleet data comes from net-misc/ctg-ssh-ca-fleet (private).
